0022600118.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-2, 0-1 at home, 4th in the Pacific and 2 games back, 14th in the West) host the Memphis Grizzlies (2-0, 1-0 on the road, 2nd in the Southwest, 5th in the West) in the third game of the Kings' season, with Sacramento on a two-game losing streak and Memphis on a two-game winning streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the 2025-26 series ended with the Kings losing 1-3, though their most recent meeting was a 123-114 Sacramento win in Memphis on February 23, 2026. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and Keegan Murray is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision, while Memphis is missing Zach Edey (ankle) and Cedric Coward is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and a game-time decision.
